text:
Mia: quick sync — post-launch afterburn planning. We need to decide which items go into the 2-week follow-on: critical bugs that hit LVU, a couple high-value UX tweaks, and the embedding consistency fix. Quick takes?

Sam: Proposed split: P0 bugs -> hotfix train (must ship in 3 days). P1 bugs -> next sprint. Enhancements ranked by impact on revenue/eng effort.

Jasper: From eng: the embedding consistency fix is tricky — ~3 engineer-days, risk of perf regression. If it's P1 we can include in next sprint but need canary.

Anika: Customer asks: two customers asked for improved error messages and a small config toggle for rerouting — both high impact for retention. Happy to prioritize if product + sales agree.

Mia: Ok. Triage suggestion:
- P0: user-facing crashes, data-loss, auth regressions
- P1: embedding drift / major UX friction
- P2: nice-to-have QoL
Also propose: reserve 20% of sprint capacity for unexpected P0/P1. Thoughts?

Jasper: Agreed. For embedding fix we should run perf tests on Dedicated config. Canary plan:
1) deploy to canary group (~5% traffic)
2) monitor latency, token-cost, and model quality (prompt tests)
3) rollback if token-cost rises > 20% or latency > +60ms.

Sam: Love that. Add acceptance criteria to each ticket: metrics thresholds + end-to-end smoke. Also add owner + rollout policy.

Anika: For the two customer asks — can we do a patch for the error messages in the hotfix, and schedule the reroute toggle for sprint+1? Sales wants commitment this week.

Mia: Yeah — error messages in hotfix. Reroute toggle next sprint. Who owns hotfix PR?

Jasper: I'll pick it up, pair with @Sam for QA. ETA 48h.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled to hotfix lane at 2024-09-18T03:00Z — CI passing.

Sam: I'll update the board and create three tickets:
- HF-embed-consistency (P1, owner Jasper)
- HF-error-msgs (P0, owner Jasper)
- EN-route-toggle (P1, owner Anika)
Link: https://go/boards/RED-123

Mia: Cool. Next steps: Sam makes the tickets and adds acceptance + rollout policy. Jasper starts PR. Anika coordinate with sales for timelines. We'll meet Friday 10am for quick sync. :thumbsup:

Jasper: :thumbsup: starting now.

Mia: closing loop — reserve capacity, tracking in console telemetry, set alerts for model-quality regression. :eyes:
